Title: STONED analogue generation by SELFIES mutation
Description: Generates up to 1,000 analogues by making random mutations to a SELFIES string, exploiting the property that any such string decodes to a valid molecule. STONED, from Nigam and colleagues, showed that this deliberately simple procedure matches far heavier generative models on many benchmarks, and it also supports interpolation between two molecules along a chemical path. No learning is involved, so output is unconstrained by training data but equally unguided by any notion of desirability.
Interpretation: Up to 1000 generated molecules produced by random mutation of the input structure.
